items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: It was his gig, and I was playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, only way I knew him was Gable. Little fellow, just about my color, only he was kind of cross-eyed. But he played a whale of a drum, you know. And he had a gig, and I had that gig with him. It was his gig, and I was playing trumpet. And he remarked, he says, "Randolph, if I hadn't seen this with my eyes, I never would have believed it." I said, "What?" "You sitting down there, giving Louis a lesson." I said, "Well, I'm showing Louis how to work up and get his chops worked back up, see."
Yeah, he had chop trouble when he came back.
